value.rationale: Negative transition entries are a direct structural failure for Markov evolution, and Crank--Nicolson is a standard \(A\)-stable second-order method. The theorem gives an exact generator-specific positivity diagnostic, not merely a sufficient step restriction, and ties it to probabilistically meaningful return resolvents. The reversible formula exposes how stationary mass and relaxation spectrum jointly control the threshold, while the unconditional classification and closed two-state/complete-graph thresholds provide concrete design and test cases.
